article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Jaylen Jones scored 16 points as Jacksonville beat Florida A&M 85-82 in overtime on Tuesday. Jones went 6 of 11 from the field (4 for 5 from 3-point range) for the Dolphins (4-4). Chris Arias scored 15 points and Evan Sterck had 14 points. Jaquan Sanders led the way for the Rattlers (0-5) with 20 points and five assists. Kaleb Washington added 16 points and two steals for Florida A&M. Tyler Shirley had 14 points, five assists and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
